translationRepairs: On renchen, Swift-as-Steeds General Xiahou Xuan arrived from the capital at Jiangling and announced an order of Empress Dowager Xuande: "The Western Palace Attendant, the Prince of Nankang, should succeed to the throne and rule the myriad people.

On renchen, Swift-as-Steeds General Xiahou Dan arrived from the capital at Jiangling and announced an order of Empress Dowager Xuande: "The Western Palace Attendant, the Prince of Nankang, should succeed to the throne and rule the myriad people.
Chinese 夏侯亶 gives the personal name 亶 (Dǎn); English Xiahou Xuan misreads it, and Xiahou Dan is the accurate correction while the rest of the sentence is unchanged.

On renchen, the Swift-as-Steeds General Xiahou Xuan arrived from the capital at Jiangling and announced an order of the Empress Dowager Xuande: "The Western Palace Attendant, the Prince of Nankang, should succeed to the imperial dignity and preside over the myriad people.

On renchen, the Swift-as-Steeds General Xiahou Dan arrived from the capital at Jiangling and announced an order of the Empress Dowager Xuande: "The Western Palace Attendant, the Prince of Nankang, should succeed to the imperial dignity and preside over the myriad people.
The same 夏侯亶 requires Xiahou Dan in the literal field; Xiahou Xuan is a naming error, and the proposed replacement fixes only that name.
On dingsi, Xiao Yinghou was made General of the Right and commander of the rear and garrison forces.
On dingsi, Xiao Yingzhou was made General of the Right and commander of the rear and garrison forces.
Chinese 蕭穎胄 ends in 胄 (zhòu); Yinghou is a wrong reading, and Xiao Yingzhou matches the graph and the chapter's other renderings of this person.
General of the Right Xiao Yinghou was made left chief clerk and advanced to General Who Pacifies the Army; the Prince of Liang was advanced to General Who Subdues the East.
General of the Right Xiao Yingzhou was made left chief clerk and advanced to General Who Pacifies the Army; the Prince of Liang was advanced to General Who Subdues the East.
Unit s0019 again names 蕭穎胄; replacing Yinghou with Yingzhou corrects the transliteration without changing offices or the Prince of Liang clause.

On renyin, Director of the Masters of Writing and General Who Pacifies the Army Xiao Yinghou died; Attendant at the Yellow Gate Xiao Dan was ordered to handle the affairs of Jing Province and the princely establishment.

On renyin, Director of the Masters of Writing and General Who Pacifies the Army Xiao Yingzhou died; Attendant at the Yellow Gate Xiao Dan was ordered to handle the affairs of Jing Province and the princely establishment.
The death notice likewise has 蕭穎胄; Xiao Yingzhou is the correct name, and the rest of the sentence about Xiao Dan is left intact.
On yiwei of the eleventh month of winter, General of the Household for All Purposes Li Yuanyi was made governor of Yu Province.
On yiwei of the eleventh month of winter, General of the Household for All Purposes Li Yuanlü was made governor of Yu Province.
Chinese 李元履 has given name 履 (lǚ); Li Yuanyi does not match that character, and Li Yuanlü is the accurate personal-name reading.
Another edict said: "I am personally leading the army to destroy these villains; with war at hand, mercy should be spread abroad.
Another edict said: "I am personally leading the host from Jinyang to cut down these criminals; with war at hand, mercy should be spread abroad.
Chinese 躬率晉陽 names Jinyang, which the idiomatic omits; the proposed wording restores that place and keeps a faithful rendering of 翦此凶孽 and the mercy clause.
